body:
1st 10 mins introduction was solid with good setup & visuals, but film falls flat right after that.Scenes with pregnant women were very disturbing and felt unnecessary.

Screenplay & editing are the biggest drawbacks, totally messed up and no flow.

Interval is just okayish, only BGM saves it to some extent.

Second half is a big disaster with zero emotional connect.Action blocks have zero impact despite loud making.

CBT Rating - 1.75/5
